items.text: The page is titled 'AEP Texas | Knowledge Is Power' and declares lang='en'. Its head has only two meta tags: charset and viewport.

items.text: The page has a single h1, 'KNOWLEDGE IS POWER.', set in all caps with a trailing period.
items.evidence: h1_count: 1; h1.text 'KNOWLEDGE IS POWER.'

items.text: Helvetica Neue is the dominant typeface on 121 elements. Arial appears on 6 elements and is also the declared fallback.
items.evidence: fonts_by_element_count: Helvetica Neue 121, Arial 6; h1 font_family '"Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif'

items.text: Body text is 16px with a line height of 24.8px, a ratio of about 1.55.

items.text: A red, rgb(218,41,28), is the single accent color. It is used for buttons, the alert banner, the outage-alert band, card titles and inline links.

items.text: Body text is a near-black, rgb(29,31,32), rather than pure black. The same color is used for the dark quick-link bar and the footer background.

features.statement: Page title is a short brand-plus-tagline phrase, with lang declared and minimal head metadata (charset and viewport only).
Hero headline is a single H1 set in all caps with a trailing period.
A single neutral sans-serif family (Helvetica Neue with Arial fallback) is used across nearly all elements.
Body text is 16px with generous line height of about 1.55.
One saturated red accent color is used consistently for buttons, banners, card titles and links.
Text and dark bars use near-black instead of pure black, including body text, quick-link bar and footer background.
Section bands alternate white and very light gray to separate content without divider lines.
A thin utility bar at the very top holds a single right-aligned underlined link.
Full-width hero photo with darkened overlay keeps the white headline readable, with a solid colored callout box beneath.
A dark bar below the hero splits quick links into equal columns separated by thin vertical dividers.
Intro sections are center-aligned: heading, short paragraph, and one accent-colored call-to-action button.
Full-width accent-colored promo band pairs a left-aligned text link and description with a right-side inverted button.
Image-and-text feature rows alternate image side, with text column vertically centered against the image.
Content sits in a centered container about 1120px wide with 160px side margins on a 1440px page.
Photography depicts real people and everyday scenes, cropped to uniform aspect ratios.
Content images have empty alt text; only the logo carries descriptive alt text.
Corners are mostly square, with only small radii and no pill shapes.
Decoration is minimal: few shadows and transitions, with no gradients, blur, animations or transforms.
Semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, footer, sections) are used, while article, aside and figure are absent.
A hidden dialog with a labeled form, such as a login modal, is present in the DOM.
Footer is dark with a bold white nav row and a prominent bold phone-number help line.
Lower footer links and legal text are small and light gray, pipe-separated, with plain-text social links instead of icons.
Copy is brief and conversational, with sparing punctuation flourishes such as an occasional exclamation mark or em dash.
Cards are white with subtle shadow and small radii, stacking image, red uppercase title and short description.
Heading hierarchy is orderly: one H1, H2 section titles, H3 card titles.
Class naming is sparse and semantic, with no utility-class framework patterns.
Layout combines CSS grid and flexbox.
